name: v0.4.0
body:
## Overview

llama.cpp 0.4.0 adds initial Qwen3.8-Flash-Next and Nemotron-3-Puzzle support, on-demand tensor reading, per-slot server context limits, video input options, and a ggml update to 0.23.0 with major sparse flash attention and RDMA work.

### API changes

- Added `llama_lazy_mode` and `lazy_mode` ([#27794](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/27794)).
- Added `max_buf_size` to quantize params ([#27795](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/27795)).
- Bumped session/state versions for KV-cell token tracking ([#27762](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/27762)).
- Added `mtmd_input_part` and `mtmd_tokenize_from_parts()` ([#28250](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/28250)).
- Made `mtmd_tokenize` const-correct ([#28310](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/28310)).
- Made `mtmd_bitmap_init_lazy` const-correct ([#28307](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/28307)).
- Added mtmd helper video/init options ([#24318](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/24318)).
- Server multimodal helpers accept `mtmd_helper_init_opt` ([#24318](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/24318)).

### New models

- Added initial Qwen3.8-Flash-Next (`qwen4exp`) architecture support; optimization improvements are still pending ([#27742](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/27742)).
- Added NVIDIA Nemotron-3-Puzzle-75B-A9B support ([#25444](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/25444)).
- Added DSpark support for Nemotron 3.5 ([#27804](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/27804)).
- Added support for nanbeige4.2-3B ([#27730](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/27730)).

### Core changes

- Added lazy tensor reading ([#27794](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/27794)).
- Renamed option to `--lazy-mode` ([#27969](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/27969)).
- Added `--n-cpu-ffn` ([#26622](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/26622)).
- Added per-layer expert routing/FFN ([#28323](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/28323)).
- Added KV-cell token tracking ([#27762](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/27762)).
- Added n-gram history lookup ([#28040](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/28040)).
- Optimized KV cache restore ([#27991](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/27991)).
- Stopped early sequence scans ([#28011](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/28011)).
- Added quantizer RAM cap ([#27795](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/27795)).
- Added quantizer row-slab streaming ([#27830](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/27830)).
- Prevented RAM peaking during load ([#27483](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/27483)).
- Autoscaled YaRN training context ([#28030](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/28030)).
- Disabled non-fused GDN/LID ([#27877](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/27877)).
- Simplified MiniMax-01 graph ([#27790](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/27790)).
- Added DFlash2 support ([#27816](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/27816)).
- Fused DFlash encoder into KV injection ([#27310](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/27310)).
- Added sparse flash attention for DeepSeek-V4/GLM and Qwen4exp ([#27970](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/27970)).
- Added Apple RDMA as an RPC transport ([#26421](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/26421)).
- Added RPC event/async backend APIs ([#18626](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/18626)).
- Fixed Qwen4exp graph issues ([#27941](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/27941)).
- Added Qwen4exp recurrent rollback ([#28123](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/28123)).
- Summed Qwen4exp indexer heads ([#28023](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/28023)).
- Reduced Qwen4exp graph splits ([#27880](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/27880)).
- Fixed DeepSeek-V4 input vision ([#28154](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/28154)).
- Fixed Gemma-4 vision handling ([#28335](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/28335)).
- Fixed Gemma-4 assistant ([#28183](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/28183)).
- Added synthetic spec acceptance options ([#27711](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/27711)).
- Made build info stream configurable ([#28322](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/28322)).
- Fixed JSON-schema empty object grammar ([#28279](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/28279)).

### Multi-modality changes

- Added `mtmd_tokenize_from_parts()` ([#28250](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/28250)).
- Added DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp ([#28133](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/28133)).
- Added DeepSeek-V4 input vision handling ([#28154](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/28154)).
- Fixed Gemma-4 vision handling ([#28335](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/28335)).
- Fixed Idefics3 preprocessing ([#28273](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/28273)).
- Fixed Qwen3-TTS ([#28231](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/28231)).
- Added video parameters/`--video-*` ([#24318](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/24318)).
- Made image preprocessors const-correct ([#28310](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/28310)).
- Made audio preprocessors const-correct ([#28307](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/28307)).

### Server changes

- Added per-slot context limit ([#24124](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/24124)).
- Accept `data:` URLs for media ([#27735](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/27735)).
- Enabled `preserve_reasoning` by default ([#28174](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/28174)).
- Reject prefilled assistant tool calls ([#27626](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/27626)).
- Added synthetic spec acceptance options ([#27711](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/27711)).
- Added pytest-xdist server tests ([#28298](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/28298)).

### UI changes

- Improved Chat Form Actions UI/UX ([#27746](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/27746)).
- Replaced MCP overrides with tool policy ([#27745](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/27745)).
- Moved Settings/MCP routes to dialogs ([#27744](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/27744)).
- Updated dialog styling ([#27743](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/27743)).
- Copy grouped agentic response text ([#27832](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/27832)).
- Updated ESLint config ([#27700](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/27700)).
- Updated package scripts ([#28270](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/28270)).

### ggml changes

- Bumped ggml from v0.22.0 to v0.23.0 ([release](https://github.com/ggml-org/ggml/releases/tag/v0.23.0)).

Version 0.23.0 adds new operators and backend scheduling APIs for sparse attention, asynchronous execution, and allocation-dependency tracking. The most notable additions are sparse flash attention (`ggml_flash_attn_ext_set_n_kv_max`), RPC event/async APIs, and Apple RDMA transport support. It also includes broad correctness and performance work across CPU, GPU, and accelerator backends.

## Assets

**Nightly build:** [b10809](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/releases/tag/b10809)

## More info

- [Releases and versioning of `ggml-org` projects](https://github.com/ggml-org/ggml/discussions/1579)
